en.name: Arrow symbols
en.title: Arrow Symbols: Copy and Paste Arrows (→ ← ↑ ↓ ⇒)
en.description: Copy and paste 20 arrow symbols: single ←↑→↓, double ⇒⇔, diagonal ↗ and return ↩ arrows. Tap a tile to copy, then paste into docs, slides, comments or chat.
en.lede: Twenty arrows for notes, slides and code comments. Tap a tile to copy it, then paste it where you need a direction or a step.

body.body: The thin arrows ← ↑ → ↓ point the way in lists and flow notes. The double arrows ⇐ ⇒ ⇔ read as logic: ⇒ means implies, and ⇔ means if and only if. The diagonal arrows ↗ ↘ show rising and falling values in a status line. The return arrows ↩ and ↪ mark a reply or a jump back.

body.h2: Typing arrows without a copy button
body.body: On a Mac, an arrow is a Character Viewer search away, and Windows users can hold Alt and type 26 for →. In code and commit messages, plain ASCII like -> is safer, because a symbol can break a parser or a terminal font. Reserve the symbols for text that humans read.

en.alt: Six blue arrows pointing right, up, in both directions, diagonally up and down
faq: Which arrow should I use for a next step?
Use → for a plain step in a list, and ➜ when the arrow should stand out as a button or a heading marker. Both look the same at small sizes in most fonts.
Are arrows safe to paste into a spreadsheet?
Yes. A cell treats them as ordinary text, but a formula only accepts ASCII operators, so keep arrows in labels and notes, not in calculations.

zh.name: 箭头符号
zh.title: 箭头符号：复制粘贴箭头（→ ← ↑ ↓ ⇒）
zh.description: 一键复制 20 个箭头符号：单线 ←↑→↓、双线 ⇒⇔、斜向 ↗ 和返回 ↩ 箭头。点击方块即可复制，用在文档、幻灯片、代码注释或聊天里。
zh.lede: 二十个箭头，用于笔记、幻灯片和代码注释。点击方块复制，再粘贴到需要表示方向或步骤的地方。

body.body: 细线箭头 ← ↑ → ↓ 在列表和流程笔记里指明方向。双线箭头 ⇐ ⇒ ⇔ 常用于逻辑：⇒ 表示推出，⇔ 表示当且仅当。斜向的 ↗ ↘ 可以在状态行里表示上升和下降。返回箭头 ↩ 和 ↪ 则标记回复或跳回。

body.h2: 没有复制按钮时怎样输入箭头
body.body: 在 Mac 上，用字符检视器搜索就能找到箭头；Windows 用户可以按住 Alt 键输入 26 得到 →。在代码和提交信息里，建议用普通的 ASCII 写法 ->，因为符号可能让解析器或终端字体出问题。符号只留给给人看的文字。

zh.alt: 六个蓝色箭头，分别指向右、上、双向、斜上和下
faq: 表示下一步该用哪个箭头？
列表里的普通步骤用 →；想让箭头像按钮或标题标记那样醒目时，用 ➜。在大多数字体里，小字号下两者看起来一样。
箭头可以粘贴到电子表格里吗？
可以。单元格会把它当作普通文字，但公式只接受 ASCII 运算符，所以箭头只放在标签和备注里，不要放进计算。
